symptom: ako/mxcli#2070 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1790): `rename page M.Old_Page to New_Page;` then `show page M.New_Page` in a microflow of the same script: check --references reported 'page not found: M.New_Page'; exec ran it and mx check reported 0 errors.
cause: collectSingle recorded a RENAME (and a cross-module MOVE) only in scriptContext.indirectDocs, which only the alter-target check (#1821) reads. Every reference check — show page, call microflow, snippet calls, navigation — consults the kind's own script-defined set (sc.pages, sc.microflows, …), so the new name was never known to them.
insight: A second registry for 'documents the script provides' drifts from the first one the moment a new reader appears. Write the indirect name into the same per-kind set the CREATEs fill, so every existing and future reference check inherits it. Verified on TestApp: check refused before, passes after; exec + mx check 0 errors.
